visualizer_enabled.label: MilkDrop visualiser
visualizer_enabled.description: Show a MilkDrop visualiser behind the fullscreen player, reacting live to the music. Each player can override this from its fullscreen menu. The waveform is tapped from the Sendspin stream, so it is only offered for players with a Sendspin output.

visualizer_blur.label: Visualiser blur
visualizer_blur.description: Softens the visualiser for a calmer background. 0 disables blur.

visualizer.provider_missing: The MilkDrop Visualiser plugin isn't available. Check it under Settings › Plugins to use the visualiser.
visualizer.preset_mode_description: How the visualiser chooses which MilkDrop preset to show.
visualizer.no_favorites: No favourites yet. Star the current preset in the fullscreen player.
visualizer.credits_milkdrop: MilkDrop was originally created by Ryan Geiss as a visualiser for Winamp. Presets are the work of the MilkDrop preset community, bundled via butterchurn-presets.
